## Versions and platform

Include the Daybook version, Python version and operating system.

## Synthetic reproduction

Provide commands and a small invented repository or transcript example.
Remove personal paths, identities, credentials and real transcript content.
Report vulnerabilities privately as described in SECURITY.md.

## Expected and observed behavior

Explain what you expected and what happened. Include sanitized error output.
